title: Kaplansky's quasitrace conjecture and failure of tensor-product stable finiteness

result.label: Kaplansky's quasitrace conjecture and failure of tensor-product stable finiteness
result.statement: Disproves Kaplansky's quasitrace conjecture by constructing a separable unital complex C ∗ -algebra admitting normalized 2-quasitraces, all of which are nonadditive. As a consequence, two unital simple stably finite C ∗ -algebras can have a properly infinite minimal tensor product, with one factor Cr^( F2).
